SCHEMA$AGENT_CONTEXT$LOAD_MEMORY$DESCRIP: The agent keeps notes under .mbilinyi/memory/ and loads them at the start of each new conversation, learning your codebase and preferences over time.
SCHEMA$CONDENSER$MAX_SIZE$DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of events kept before the condenser runs.
SCHEMA$CONDENSER$CONDENSER_KIND$DESCRIPT: How the condenser shortens long conversations. LLM Summarizer replaces older events with a summary written by the LLM; None keeps the full history.
SCHEMA$CONDENSER$MAX_TOKENS$DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of tokens allowed before the condenser runs. Leave empty to condense based on the number of events only.
SCHEMA$CONDENSER$KEEP_FIRST$DESCRIPTION: Number of events at the start of the conversation that are always kept when condensing.
SCHEMA$CONDENSER$MINIMUM_PROGRESS$DESCRI: Minimum fraction of events (0 to 1) that must be condensed for a condensation to count as successful.
SCHEMA$CONDENSER$HARD_CONTEXT_RESET_MAX_: How many times the condenser attempts a hard context reset before reporting an error.
SCHEMA$CONDENSER$HARD_CONTEXT_RESET_CONT: Factor used to shrink event text when summarizing fails after a hard context reset.
SCHEMA$CONFIRMATION_MODE$DESCRIPTION: Require user confirmation before executing risky actions.
SCHEMA$LLM$API_KEY$DESCRIPTION: API key for authenticating with the LLM provider.
SCHEMA$LLM$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID$DESCRIPTION: AWS access key ID for authentication.
SCHEMA$LLM$AWS_ROLE_NAME$DESCRIPTION: AWS role name for assuming roles.
SCHEMA$LLM$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY$DESCRIP: AWS secret access key for authentication.
SCHEMA$LLM$AWS_SESSION_TOKEN$DESCRIPTION: AWS session token for temporary credentials.
SCHEMA$LLM$DISABLE_VISION$DESCRIPTION: Disable image processing for vision-capable models.
SCHEMA$LLM$ENABLE_ENCRYPTED_REASONING$DE: Request encrypted reasoning content in Responses API.
SCHEMA$LLM$EXTENDED_THINKING_BUDGET$DESC: Budget tokens for extended thinking (Anthropic models).
SCHEMA$LLM$EXTRA_HEADERS$DESCRIPTION: Optional HTTP headers to forward to LiteLLM requests.
SCHEMA$LLM$INPUT_COST_PER_TOKEN$DESCRIPT: Cost per input token for logging purposes.
SCHEMA$LLM$LITELLM_EXTRA_BODY$DESCRIPTIO: Additional parameters to pass to LiteLLM requests.
SCHEMA$LLM$LOG_COMPLETIONS_FOLDER$DESCRI: Folder to log LLM completions to.
SCHEMA$LLM$MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS$DESCRIPTION: Approximate maximum characters in each event/content sent to the LLM.
SCHEMA$LLM$MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS$DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of output tokens the model may generate.
SCHEMA$LLM$MODEL_CANONICAL_NAME$DESCRIPT: Canonical model name for feature registry lookups.
SCHEMA$LLM$NUM_RETRIES$DESCRIPTION: Number of retry attempts for failed requests.
SCHEMA$LLM$OUTPUT_COST_PER_TOKEN$DESCRIP: Cost per output token for logging purposes.
SCHEMA$LLM$REASONING_EFFORT$DESCRIPTION: The effort to put into reasoning (low, medium, high, xhigh, or none).
SCHEMA$LLM$REASONING_SUMMARY$DESCRIPTION: Level of detail for reasoning summaries (auto, concise, or detailed).
SCHEMA$LLM$RETRY_MAX_WAIT$DESCRIPTION: Maximum wait time between retries in seconds.
SCHEMA$LLM$RETRY_MIN_WAIT$DESCRIPTION: Minimum wait time between retries in seconds.
SCHEMA$LLM$RETRY_MULTIPLIER$DESCRIPTION: Multiplier for exponential backoff between retries.
SCHEMA$LLM$STREAM$DESCRIPTION: Enable streaming responses from the LLM.
SCHEMA$LLM$TEMPERATURE$DESCRIPTION: Controls randomness in model responses. Lower values are more deterministic.
SCHEMA$LLM$TOP_K$DESCRIPTION: Limits token selection to the K most likely tokens.
SCHEMA$LLM$TOP_P$DESCRIPTION: Controls nucleus sampling by limiting token selection to the smallest set whose cumulative probability exceeds this value.
SCHEMA$LLM$USAGE_ID$DESCRIPTION: Unique usage identifier for the LLM.
SCHEMA$MAX_ITERATIONS$DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of iterations the conversation will run before stopping.
SCHEMA$MCP_CONFIG$DESCRIPTION: MCP server configuration for the agent.
SCHEMA$SECURITY_ANALYZER$DESCRIPTION: Security analyzer that evaluates actions before execution.
SCHEMA$TOOL_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT$DESCRIPTIO: Maximum number of tool calls the agent runs at the same time in one step. 1 runs them one after another (default). Higher values run tool calls in parallel; they share the conversation, files and working directory, so changes to shared state can conflict.
SCHEMA$VERIFICATION$CONFIRMATION_MODE$DE: Require user confirmation before executing risky actions.
SCHEMA$VERIFICATION$CRITIC_API_KEY$DESCR: If MBILINYI is selected as your active LLM provider, leave this empty; the critic reuses that provider's key. Otherwise, provide a critic API key from the link below.
SCHEMA$VERIFICATION$CRITIC_API_KEY$HELP_: If MBILINYI is selected as your active LLM provider, leave this empty because the Critic API Key is the same as your MBILINYI Provider LLM Key, which you can find in the
section of MBILINYI Cloud; otherwise, enter a Critic API Key from that page.
SCHEMA$VERIFICATION$CRITIC_ENABLED$DESCR: Enable critic evaluation for the agent.
SCHEMA$VERIFICATION$CRITIC_THRESHOLD$DES: Critic success threshold used for iterative refinement.
SCHEMA$VERIFICATION$ENABLE_ITERATIVE_REF: Automatically retry tasks when critic scores fall below the threshold.
SCHEMA$VERIFICATION$MAX_REFINEMENT_ITERA: Maximum number of refinement attempts after critic feedback.
SCHEMA$VERIFICATION$SECURITY_ANALYZER$DE: Security analyzer that evaluates actions before execution.

SETTINGS$VERSION_UPDATE_MESSAGE: You're on {{installed}}. To update to {{latest}}, copy a command below, run it in your terminal, then restart MBILINYI IDE.
CHILD_CONVERSATION$LAUNCH_FAILED: Could not launch the child conversation: {{error}}
SIDEBAR$ONBOARDING_CHECKLIST_CONFIGURE_L: Connect your LLM provider and API key so the agent can reason and respond. Open LLM Settings to add or edit a profile.
SIDEBAR$ONBOARDING_CHECKLIST_CONNECT_MCP: MCP servers give your agent access to external tools like GitHub, Slack, or search. Browse the MCP marketplace or add a custom server.
SIDEBAR$ONBOARDING_CHECKLIST_START_CHAT_: Open a chat and send your first message. The agent can run commands, edit files, and help with code in your workspace.
SIDEBAR$ONBOARDING_CHECKLIST_SCHEDULE_TA: Automations run on a schedule or trigger. Create a scheduled task to have the agent work for you in the background.
SIDEBAR$ONBOARDING_CHECKLIST_CUSTOMIZE_D: Choose or create an agent profile to control which agent and model run your conversations.
SIDEBAR$ONBOARDING_CHECKLIST_JOIN_SLACK_: Meet other MBILINYI users and the team. Open the Slack invite to join the conversation.
ONBOARDING$SETUP_GUIDE_TOUR_TEMPLATE_BOD: Pick an automation to start from. Its setup opens next.
ONBOARDING$SETUP_GUIDE_TOUR_AUTOMATION_B: Fill in the details, review them and create the automation. The guide moves on once it is created.
ONBOARDING$SETUP_GUIDE_TOUR_MCP_ADD_BODY: Pick a server from the library to set it up.
ONBOARDING$SETUP_GUIDE_TOUR_MCP_FORM_BOD: Enter the server's details and save it. The guide moves on once the server is added.
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$SUBTITLE: Sync automations to a git repository so they persist across restarts and can be shared.
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$ENABLED_HELP: Sync is on as soon as a repository is configured. Turn this off to pause syncing without losing the configuration.
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$SYNC_DISABLED_ERROR: Enable Git Sync before triggering a sync.
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$AUTHOR_HELP: Leave blank to use the backend's default commit author.
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$TOKEN_HELP: Required for private repositories. Leave blank to keep the existing token unchanged.
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$TOKEN_PLACEHOLDER: Leave blank to keep the current token
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$KEY_SET_PLACEHOLDER: An encryption key is currently set
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$ENCRYPTION_KEY_HELP: Optional. Encrypts automation files before they are committed, so the repository stores ciphertext instead of readable YAML. Keep a copy of the key — without it the repository cannot be read or restored.
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$CHECK_FAILED_TITLE: Could not reach the repository with these settings
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$CHECK_FAILED_HINT: Fix the settings above, or press Save again to store them anyway.
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$NO_ACCESS_TITLE: Git Sync is managed by organization admins
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$NO_ACCESS_MESSAGE: Only organization admins and owners can view and configure Git Sync.
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$UNSUPPORTED_TITLE: Git Sync is not available on this backend
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$UNSUPPORTED_MESSAGE: The automation backend is running a version without the Git Sync API. Update it to a version that supports Git Sync.
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$INTERVAL_HELP: Set to 0 to sync only when you press Sync now.
SETTINGS$PROFILE_BROKEN_CONNECTION_TOOLT: The linked provider connection was deleted. Edit this profile to re-link it.
SETTINGS$PROVIDER_CONNECTIONS_EMPTY: No provider connections yet. Add one to share an API key across models.
SETTINGS$PROVIDER_CONNECTIONS_SUBLINE: Share one API key across multiple models.
SETTINGS$PROVIDER_CONNECTION_DELETE_CONF: Are you sure you want to delete the connection "{{name}}"?
SETTINGS$PROVIDER_CONNECTION_ROTATE_HINT: Leave blank to keep the current key.
HOME$ISOLATED_WORKSPACE_NOTICE: This backend uses isolated workspaces. Host folders and projects cannot be attached.
SETTINGS$AGENT_PROFILE_SECRETS_ALL_HINT: Allows secrets supplied when the agent starts. For automations, choose secrets explicitly in this profile.
SETTINGS$AGENT_PROFILE_SYSTEM_PROMPT_APP: Your instructions are added after the built-in MBILINYI instructions, which stay in place.
Instructions to add, e.g. how to answer or what to avoid.
SETTINGS$AGENT_PROFILE_SYSTEM_PROMPT_CUS: Replaces MBILINYI' built-in persona and coding workflow. Memory, security and tool guidance, skills, repository instructions and runtime context are still included.
SETTINGS$AGENT_PROFILE_SYSTEM_PROMPT_DEF: The default profile always uses the MBILINYI system prompt. Create a named profile to customize it.
SETTINGS$AGENT_PROFILE_SYSTEM_PROMPT_PLA: Describe who this agent is and how it should work.
SETTINGS$AGENT_PROFILE_SYSTEM_PROMPT_REQ: Enter the text, or switch back to the MBILINYI IDE default.
SETTINGS$AGENT_PROFILE_SYSTEM_PROMPT_STA: Uses the built-in MBILINYI IDE instructions for coding, security and tool use.
SETTINGS$AGENT_PROFILE_SECRETS_CHOOSE_HI: This agent can use only the secrets you select — make sure it has everything it needs. An external agent needs its own provider credentials to sign in.
SETTINGS$AGENT_PROFILE_SECRETS_NONE: You have not saved any secrets yet.
SETTINGS$MODEL_NOT_LISTED_HELP: This model is not listed by this backend. Edit the profile or ask an administrator to configure it.
BACKEND$ORGANIZATIONS_LOAD_FAILED: Could not load your workspaces. Check your connection and try again.
BACKEND$ORGANIZATIONS_EMPTY: No accessible workspaces are available. Ask your administrator to check your access.
BACKEND$ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED: {{name}} is suspended. Contact your administrator to restore access.
BACKEND$MEMBERSHIP_SUSPENDED: Your access to {{name}} is suspended. Contact your administrator to restore it.
SETTINGS$APPS_VIEW_UNAVAILABLE: This app view is not available yet. Check that its backend is ready, then try again.
CHAT_INTERFACE$DICTATION_FAILED: Dictation failed. Check microphone access and your voice input settings.
SETTINGS$VOICE_INPUT_DESCRIPTION: The microphone button in the chat input uses your browser's speech recognition. To use your own transcription service instead, such as a local Whisper server, enter an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. These settings are stored in this browser only.
NOT_FOUND$MESSAGE: This address does not match any page. Check the URL, or go back to the home page.
SCHEMA$ENABLE_SWITCH_LLM_TOOL$DESCRIPTIO: Allow the agent to move this conversation to another saved LLM profile on its own. Disable to remove that tool.
SCHEMA$ENABLE_SWITCH_LLM_TOOL$LABEL: Let the agent switch LLM profiles
LAUNCH$TRUST_SKILL_CHECKBOX: I trust this skill from {{sources}} with the agent secrets defined in my account.
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$ENABLE_BLOCKED_ERRO: Git Sync must be enabled in the automation backend's environment, and the service restarted, before it can be turned on here.
AUTOMATIONS$GIT_SYNC$NOT_LOCAL_MESSAGE: Git Sync is only available when connected to a local MBILINYI IDE backend.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$SCHEDULE_DESCRIPTION: Run on an interval or at a set time
AUTOMATION_SETUP$EVENT_DESCRIPTION: Run when GitHub, Slack, or Linear fires
AUTOMATION_SETUP$ASK_AGENT_EVENT_PROMPT: Help me set the event trigger. Ask what should start this automation, then fill the event source, event key, and any event filter.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$EVENT_PUBLIC_URL_NOTICE: Event sources need a public URL to deliver webhooks to this instance.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$PLUGIN_REQUIRED: Add a plugin source before continuing.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$ENTRYPOINT_REQUIRED: Add an entrypoint command before continuing.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$SETUP_SCRIPT_PATH_REQUI: Add a setup script path before continuing.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$SETUP_SCRIPT_REQUIRED: Add a setup script before continuing.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$CONVERSATION_COMPOSER_P: What do you want to automate?
AUTOMATION_SETUP$GITHUB_TOKEN_REQUIRED_T: Configure a provider token secret, e.g. "GITHUB_TOKEN", in the Settings page to see repo options.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$EXISTING_BUNDLE_HELP: This automation uses an existing bundle. To edit the code, ask the agent to download the tarball, make changes, and update the automation bundle.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$DRAFT_STATUS_DESCRIPTIO: This draft is saved on the automation service. Test runs appear below.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$TEST_RUNS_EMPTY_DESCRIP: Run a test to see results here.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$DRAFT_MISSING: The draft no longer exists as part of this conversation. Continue chatting with the agent to create a fresh automation form.
AUTOMATIONS$SAVED_DRAFTS_DESCRIPTION: Setup form saved before an automation is created.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$DELETE_DRAFT_MESSAGE: Delete “{{name}}”? This removes the saved setup draft, but does not delete any final automations.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$TEST_EVENT_PAYLOAD_DESC: Save & test sends this JSON as a synthetic event payload. Use values that satisfy your event filter.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$TEST_EVENT_PAYLOAD_PLAC: Enter a JSON object to use as the test event payload
AUTOMATION_SETUP$TEST_EVENT_PAYLOAD_INVA: Enter a valid JSON object before testing this event automation.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$EXISTING_TEST_PAYLOAD_N: Existing automation tests use the backend’s default synthetic event payload. To test a custom payload, create or edit through a draft first. Support for testing existing automations with custom payloads is coming soon.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$CUSTOM_WEBHOOK_TITLE: Register this as a custom webhook source
AUTOMATION_SETUP$CUSTOM_WEBHOOK_DESCRIPT: Use this when the event source is not already listed. MBILINYI will create a webhook URL for the source before saving or testing the automation.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$CUSTOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET_H: If the external service already gave you a signing secret, paste it here. Otherwise MBILINYI generates one and shows it once after registration.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$CUSTOM_WEBHOOK_SOURCE_R: Enter an event source before registering a custom webhook.
AUTOMATION_SETUP$CUSTOM_WEBHOOK_ALREADY_: Webhook source {{source}} already exists, so this automation will use the existing source.
